description: This file defines the Error class used for error handling and reporting within a PHP application, including methods for adding errors, generating HTML error reports, and checking for existing errors.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: A class for managing error messages, including storing errors, rendering them as HTML, and checking if errors exist.

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Adds an error message with command, message, line, and file information to the error list.

methods.name: ErrorsAsHTML
methods.description: Returns a string containing an HTML table of all logged errors, with warnings formatted separately.

methods.name: ErrorsExist
methods.description: Checks if there are any errors logged and returns true if so.
